item.title: 4 ways to cope with constant thoughts about your body image
item.description: Obsessing over your looks should not take up all your energy, says psychologist Diana Hill. If you're struggling with uncomfortable thoughts about your body, ground yourself with these techniques.

item.title: This house trumpets its history in the face of gentrification. Now it's a landmark
item.description: A house in San Francisco covered in the painted faces of Latin rock artists was formally landmarked by the city. Its neighborhood has seen skyrocketing home prices and decades of redevelopment.

item.title: 'Pluribus' star Rhea Seehorn says no thanks to a world dictated by groupthink
item.description: Seehorn is up for an Emmy for her role in the Apple TV series, in which she plays a woman who suddenly finds herself surrounded by people who are inexplicably happy. Originally broadcast Dec. 9, 2025.

item.title: Fresh Air remembers Tim Curry, star of 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show'
item.description: Best known for playing the cross-dressing scientist Dr. Frank-N-Furter in the '75 cult classic, Curry also appeared in numerous other TV shows and films. He died Aug. 25. Originally broadcast in 2005.
